module: External "TV / fan" camera (disabled by default): places random fixed cameras along the vehicle's predicted path, changes viewpoint every 1.5 to ~4 s (or if the vehicle is hidden > 0.5 s, or moves too far away), and passes the result through a chain of filters: predictor, autozoom, autopoint, noise, smooth, handheld, bobbing. Two randomly drawn styles: fan (camera at human height, shaky) or TV (stable); the fan probability comes from the 'cameraFanVsTV' setting (0.66 for TV by default, see notes). Checks visibility with static rays (up to 40 tries). Returns a constructor.
notes: No fan camera under OpenXR (isFanMode = false); aiming offsets are ignored in OpenXR.

Bug: in update, the line `self:applyOffset(nx, ny, nz, findRandomAttachedNodePosition(data.veh), openxrSessionRunning)` uses a global variable openxrSessionRunning (nil) instead of data.openxrSessionRunning.
Inconsistency: switchCamera writes self.predictor.future while the predictor filter reads dtFuture; the randomly drawn value therefore has no effect (dtFuture stays 0.1).
tvModeOdds = 'cameraFanVsTV' setting and the test is `math.random() > tvModeOdds` for fan mode: a high value therefore gives more TV (inferred from code).

The signatures of the extracted page are inaccurate: switchCamera(carVel, carPos, veh, nx, ny, nz, carStopped, openxrSessionRunning), shouldSwitchCamera(carPos, carVel, dt), applyOffset(nx, ny, nz, offset, openxrSessionRunning), findNewCamPosVel(carPos, futureCarPos, velLength, chancesMultiplier, carStopped), randomizeOffsetSpeeds(paused, carStopped).

C.desc: External mode. Fields: isFanMode, camPos, camVel, camChangeTimeMin/Base/Max, invisibleTime, and the filters autozoom, autopoint, noise, smooth, bobbing, handheld, predictor.

init.desc: Initializes the state, timers and filters, then calls onSettingsChanged, onVehicleCameraConfigChanged and reset.

onSettingsChanged.desc: Hook: re-reads cameraFanVsTV and relays to the bobbing filter.

setRefNodes.desc: Sets the vehicle's reference nodes (also for autopoint).

reset.desc: Forces the choice of a new camera on the next frame ("switch to a new camera").

findNewCamPosVel.desc: Chooses a camera position near the vehicle's predicted future position, and the pan speed (zero in fan mode).

chancesMultiplier.desc: 1 to 0: restricts the draw area over the tries

applyOffset.desc: Sets the point aimed at by autopoint (vehicle-local offset, ignored in OpenXR).

switchCamera.desc: Chooses a new viewpoint: draws the style (fan/TV), the zoom steps and the durations, then looks for a clear location (40 tries), and sets handheld, noise, smooth.

shouldSwitchCamera.desc: Says whether to change camera: start, or minimum delay elapsed and (vehicle invisible too long or too far after the maximum delay).

randomizeOffsetSpeeds.desc: Draws the change period of the aimed point and the autopoint spring.

camTeleported.desc: The camera teleported: resets autozoom and handheld.

update.desc: Main loop: handles teleports, the change of aimed point and camera, moves the camera, then passes data through the filters.
